letter:
To: the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency (SFMTA)
Subject: Request for safety study at Fulton Street & 4th Avenue

Dear colleagues at SFMTA,

I am writing to ask for a safety study at the junction of Fulton Street & 4th Avenue for the roads under your responsibility (4th Avenue, Fulton Street).

The official record for the 5 years from 4 November 2021 shows 1 crash and 1 injury crash, with 0 people killed. Using the U.S. DOT's official values for the cost of crashes (2024 dollars), the harm is valued at $0.1 million per year. The latest recorded safety project was a painted safety zone in 2021. The record shows this corner already has Crosswalk Visibility Enhancements.

This corner got painted safety zones in 2021. Across the city, the city's own record neither shows this treatment worked nor rules it out, so repeating it here rests on other evidence. Please consider a different approach and check site conditions first.

This corner got continental crosswalks. Across the city, the city's own record neither shows this treatment worked nor rules it out, so repeating it here rests on other evidence. Please consider a different approach and check sight lines, lighting, and markings on site before deciding.

Thank you for considering this request.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Your organisation or address]

- DataSF, Traffic Crashes Resulting in Injury (ubvf-ztfx)
- DataSF, Continental Crosswalks (g9zy-srvv); DataSF, Painted Safety Zones (vtn2-q8ky)
